تزعزعت (form IIq)
# تَزَعْزَعْتُ (tazaʕzaʕtu) /ta.zaʕ.zaʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَزَعْزَعَ (tazaʕzaʕa)
# تَزَعْزَعْتَ (tazaʕzaʕta) /ta.zaʕ.zaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَزَعْزَعَ (tazaʕzaʕa)
# تَزَعْزَعْتِ (tazaʕzaʕti) /ta.zaʕ.zaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَزَعْزَعَ (tazaʕzaʕa)
# تَزَعْزَعَتْ (tazaʕzaʕat) /ta.zaʕ.za.ʕat/: t
